description: This file defines the ExceptionContext class within the org.apache.commons.math3.exception.util package. It provides the implementation of exception handling context, including storing localizable messages, context data, and serialization logic, used by Apache Commons Math library exceptions.

classes.name: ExceptionContext
classes.description: Implements detailed exception context management, including message formatting, context key-value storage, and serialization.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the throwable associated with this exception context.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a localized, formatted message pattern with arguments to the context.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the context data.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific key in the context.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the set of all context keys.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the composed message string in default locale.

methods.name: getLocalizedMessage
methods.description: Returns the composed message string in default locale.

methods.name: getMessage(Locale)
methods.description: Returns the message string formatted for the specified locale.

methods.name: getMessage(Locale, String)
methods.description: Returns the message string formatted for the specified locale with a custom separator.
